data.name: GOOD NEIGHBORS
data.detailed_description:
Bury a body. But not in your yard.
Every house on this street is full of real players. And every player is a serial killer.
Bury yours in theirs before they bury theirs in yours.
Welcome to GOOD NEIGHBORS.

You and your friends are serial killers in the suburbs. But so is everyone else.
Knock out NPCs, then drag and bury them in other real players' yards to frame them.
Play with friends against strangers, or against friends.

  • This is a suburbs social multiplayer online co-op game.

  • You have a house. You are a serial killer.

  • Your friends can be with you in the same house, or play against you in other houses.
    If your friends are playing with you, other houses will have real other friend groups.

  • Take down NPCs that roam the streets at night, then drag and bury them in other real players' yards.

  • Every house on this street has a real player, and each one is a serial killer too.

  • Frame the other serial killers by burying bodies in their yards to frame them.

  • You may also team up with other serial killers in the neighborhood to frame others. 2v1 always wins 1v1.

  • The house with the most bodies buried in their yard by the end of the session wins.

  • Teams mode available. Play with friends against strangers, or against friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 @ 3.3 GHz or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050-TI or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
